bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id WHERE a.kind='recruitment' AND d.status='sent' AND d.inline_buttons::text LIKE '%?start=a_%'" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 73;; esac; if test "$n" -gt 0; then exit 82; fi; echo NO_LEGACY_APPLICATION_BUTTONS
